answer: Anchor each agent identity to a stake locked in a shared vault: creating an identity requires depositing funds that are slashed if the agent misbehaves, so a Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately. Like basalt, the cost is dense and hard to fake at scale — spawning ten thousand sock puppets means locking ten thousand stakes, while honest agents pay once and keep working. The vault returns the stake when the agent retires cleanly, so the barrier punishes fakes, not newcomers.
